title: MY TINY SEED HUGGED A GIANT TROLL

editions.tiny-seed-clean.mp4: CLEAN edition for Facebook, TikTok and YouTube. Ends on the end screen (WOULD YOU SAY "HUG"? / A: HUG, B: RUN / FOLLOW FOR MORE "IN THIS TOWN"). No music bed: Claude adds music in the finishing pass.
editions.tiny-seed.mp4: Flashloop SPONSOR edition for Instagram: the same film with the small Flashloop logo card top right throughout, then the approved Sponsor Ending V2 (fixed voice file, phone prompt "A tiny seed hugs a giant troll.") after the end screen.

summary: On Harvest Day everyone brings their giant plants to the measuring pillar; the narrator's seed is a dot that measures 1. A baby rock troll stomps in and squishes the pie table, she plants her dot and it shoots up into a giant blossoming tree that hugs the troll like a teddy: 9,001. The tree fixes the table, hands her a golden apple, and she keeps it over the champion's mountain of gold. The old garden keeper grabs her arm, shaking: tiny seeds don't listen to anyone, not in a thousand years, but this one hugged when she said hug. Then a shadow covers the sun: the troll's mother steps onto the hill, 900,000. Everybody runs, her tree doesn't; it wraps its branches round her and her little sister and waits for one word.
frame_0: The giant blossoming tree (golden apples glowing, knothole face smiling) hugging the baby rock troll like a teddy in the sunny harvest square, the narrator small in front seen from behind, the measuring pillar beside her showing 9,001. Title MY TINY SEED / HUGGED A GIANT TROLL in the top band (TINY SEED in the accent green), handle top left. Frame 0 is a sharp still: it holds ~1.6 s under the title while line 1 starts, then the Toybox whip-blur (3 frames) cuts into the story.
camera: Toybox Fable locked framing with Torchlit Blocktale camera moves: a slow push-in (~6.5%/s) with a very small handheld wobble on almost every shot; the package's three reveal moves (the dot shooting up with a fast tilt, the mother's foot landing on the hill, the slow tilt up her). Cuts on the captions, a new shot about every 1-1.5 s.

package_differences: v2 is the fix round for the Fri 11-27 9:55 AM review of v1 (main 9820242). Every stand-in is swapped for Claude's model pack from tiny-seed/models/ on scripts-inbox (commit 3ffc39d, landed 12:31 AM CT; read from FETCH_HEAD 50ae37a): tree stages A-E on the TS_Tree rig with TS_TREE_HUG (line 10), TS_TREE_GIVE on the free arm while the other arm keeps the troll (line 18), TS_TREE_PROTECT (line 36) and LOOKDOWN with BLINK (line 28); the baby rock troll with GRUMPY (lines 6-7), SURPRISED (line 10), GIGGLE (line 22) and SNIFFLE (line 30); the troll mother (STERN, 440 BU; every camera's clip end is 8000); the champion's oak, the bushes, the measuring pillar, the pie tables (normal, SQUISHED, then fixed) and the golden apples.

Built and rendered in Blender 5.1.2 on Jake's PC (Cycles GPU, OptiX on the RTX 4070 Ti), natively at 1080x1920 with 6 samples + OpenImageDenoise; nothing is upscaled. The model pack is a Blender 5.3 file: it appends cleanly into 5.1 (rig, shape keys, face swaps and materials checked against a 5.3 render of the same frames), so the .glb backups were not needed. Post (captions, cards, end screen, sponsor ending, sound, encode) runs in Claude's cloud workspace as in v1.

Line 32 (82 s): the hill behind the town is a real grassy hill (about 300 BU across, 55 BU high, with little trees on it) and the mother's mossy foot lands on its top; the next shot shows her standing on it so the hill reads small.

Line 34 (86.5 s): one wide shot from 1,250 BU out on the line at right angles to the tree and the mother, so our 102 BU tree and the 440 BU mother stand at the same depth; the tree's crown reaches the top of her stubby legs (the model's knee and hip are close together). To fit both in a 9:16 frame she has stridden up to the town wall for this shot (about 190 BU from the tree) and steps back out to 400 BU for the ending, where her face has to clear the canopy.

Lines 24-26 (58-68 s): the garden keeper's hat is tipped back 24 degrees and a soft fill light sits under the brim in her shots, so her eyes and mouth read in every close-up; line 24 is now a side two-shot with her face and her shaking hand on the narrator's arm in frame.
Line 7 (15.5 s): the squish is reframed so the troll's whole head and grumpy face and its foot landing on the pie table are all in frame.
Line 4 (9 s, "Mine's a dot"): reframed on her face with the dot in the soil below it.

Line 36 (90 s): with the stock TS_TREE_PROTECT pose the ring of branches is about 50 BU across around two 5 BU girls, so a frame that shows the whole ring made them specks. As MODELS.md allows, the arm bends are eased (20 degrees on TS_ArmL/R_02): the branches come down to the girls' height, the ring tightens to about 37 BU and the leafy hands close in front of them, filmed from the front gap with the tree's face looking down. The baby troll has scooted off toward its mother, and the seed table, the runners and the bunting row in front are out of that shot.

Staging follows the model poses, which have fixed reach: the troll is hugged where TS_TREE_HUG expects it (18.5 BU in front of the trunk), the table it squishes stands where the tree's free arm pats it on line 17, and the narrator stands where TS_TREE_GIVE's hand reaches (lines 18-29).

Frame 0 / cover is re-staged around the model pillar (8.3 BU tall, its panel at 3.75 BU, much lower than v1's stand-in): the camera comes round so the narrator stands beside the pillar, seen from behind, under the tree hugging the giggling troll. The pillar's own 9,001 is too small to read at phone size, so the small 9,001 number card rides on its panel during the 1.6 s cover shot (as in v1).

Kept exactly as in v1: the approved voice, the one-word captions, the number cards (50 / 9,000 / 1 / 9,001 / 900,000, and 9,001 shrinking to a pebble on line 34), the A/B chips, the split frame on line 20, the two flash inserts on line 26, the end screen and the Flashloop ending (its story background is the v2 picture).
Sound effects are synthesised in the build (as in v1), re-cued to the v2 picture; no music bed.
The every-frame screen flags the planned white flash-ins of line 26's two flash inserts (each fades in over 3 frames); they are not glitches.
Clean edition runs 96.0 s: the 94.1 s voice plus a short hold of the end screen; sponsor edition adds the 9.3 s Flashloop ending.
